titre_page: How to create your own music in Yop2D? | Yop2D Guide
description: Compose a music in Yop2D without knowing music: ready-made blocks on 4 tracks (melody, chords, bass, drums), real instruments, loop, and a .ogg file for your game.
h1: How to create your own music?
carte: Stack ready-made blocks on 4 tracks and get a music for your game.
etapes: Add ready-made blocks and drop them on the 4 tracks.
Touch "Create the sound (.ogg)", then play it with a node.
blocs: You do not need to know music. A music is made of **blocks** (small pieces of a few bars) that you place on **4 tracks**: Melody, Chords, Bass and Drums. The sounds are real instruments (piano, soft strings, bass, drums), free to use (CC0): you can use your music in games you sell.
a project open in the editor;
Android 10 or newer (older phones cannot create the sound).
At the top, touch the **Music** button, next to Animations and Title styles.
Touch **▶ Play** at any time to hear what you have; touch it again to stop.
Your work is kept as a draft: you can close the tool and come back with **Open**.
Touch **＋ Block**. The ready-made blocks are sorted by style (Calm, Action, Mystery, Joyful, Dungeon, Pirate, Sad). Touch ▶ next to a block to hear it, then touch its line to add it.
Your blocks appear under "My blocks". Touch one to choose it, then touch a box of its track to place it. Slide your finger to the right to repeat it.
To remove a block, choose the **Eraser** and touch it.
Change the speed with the ♩ button and the length with the bars button. Tick **Loop** so the music restarts without any cut.
A block only goes on its own track (a drum block on the Drums track). On the Melody and Chords tracks, touch the track name to change the instrument (piano or strings).
Touch **＋ Block**, then **✎ Create my own block…**, and choose the track and the length.
In the note editor, touch to place a note, slide to the right to make it longer, touch a note again to remove it.
No idea? Touch **Give me an idea**: Yop2D proposes notes that always sound good. Touch **Keep** when you like it.
Step 4: create the sound and play it
Touch **Create the sound (.ogg)**, give it a name and choose the **Sounds** folder (or one of its sub-folders).
When it is ready, touch **Use this music**, or keep editing.
In the Blueprint, add [[jouer_musique]] (for example right after the start event) and choose your music: it plays like any other music.
The .ogg file is a normal sound of your project: it is exported with your game, even offline.
**There is no Music button:** the tool needs Android 10 or newer.
**"Place a few blocks first":** place at least one block on a track before touching Play.
**The block does not fit:** make the music longer (bars button) or choose another box.
